bog_spare_cry: throws back his head and roars a war cry, a spare horn hanging at his belt, his shield lowered.
bog_drop_guard: lets his great black shield fall into the mud and swings his mace two-handed at a hunched dark creature.
bog_reckless: charges headlong with no shield at all, mace raised high, his mail torn open across the chest.
bog_shield_wall: @three battered round wooden shields locked edge to edge in a row on a muddy field at dusk, spears behind them.
bog_unbending: kneels on one knee in the rain, leaning on his shield, a broken arrow shaft standing in his shoulder, refusing to fall.
bog_valor_burst: brings his six-flanged mace down in one huge overhead blow onto a hunched creature, his whole body behind it.
bog_stand_for_all: stands with his shield before three small frightened villagers huddled behind him in a burnt doorway.
bog_hold_to_the_end: alone and wounded, dark red paint on his mail, holds a narrow bridge against shadowy shapes.
bog_battle_fury: tears off his iron face mask and bares his teeth, veins standing out on his neck, eyes wild.
bog_toss_aside: sweeps a table clear with one arm, cups, bread and a map flying, before grabbing his mace.
